mapper.insert: insert into user_address( user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, region, detail_address, postal_code, is_default, is_top ) values ( #{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{region}, #{detailAddress}, #{postalCode}, #{isDefault}, #{isTop} )
mapper.select: select id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, region, detail_address, postal_code, is_default, is_top, create_time, update_time from user_address where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0 order by is_default desc, is_top desc, update_time desc
mapper.update: update `user_address` set receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, region = #{region}, detail_address = #{detailAddress}, postal_code = #{postalCode}, is_default = #{isDefault}, is_top = #{isTop} where user_id = #{userId} and id = #{id} and deleted = 0
update `user_address` set is_default = 0 where user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0
